responsibility: Implements DJGPP-specific backend helpers for section emission and LTO debug handling on x86 COFF output. It provides the named-section hook that prints DJGPP section flags, including special one-byte alignment for LTO sections, and the target asm LTO start/end hooks that temporarily disable debug info because early LTO debug is not supported for this COFF environment.
same_name_distinction: Unlike djgpp.h and djgpp.opt, this is the implementation file for DJGPP-specific target hooks, providing code for named-section emission and LTO debug start/end handling; it is executable hook logic rather than target-macro definitions or option declarations.
